base_member_text: [L140-L142] (MED/configuration-path) MPI_Debug|x64 writes module files to bin\dynamic\win32\$(ConfigurationName) while its output/object paths are x64, mixing architecture-specific module artifacts.
audit_member_text: [L141] (MED/configuration-contamination) MPI_Debug|x64 writes modules into the win32 dynamic directory.

adversarial.rationale: MPI_Debug|x64 explicitly directs module files to bin\dynamic\win32\$(ConfigurationName), also used by MPI_Debug|Win32. Both compiled files define modules (introspection.F90:1 and libxbeach_dynamic.F90:1), so the setting applies to real generated artifacts; x64 object/output directories and static-library include paths do not neutralize it.

base_member_text: [L74-L86,L162-L179] (MED/configuration-contract) The MPI_netcdf configurations have no USEMPI or USENETCDF-related PreprocessorDefinitions, so their feature-combined names are not reflected in the compiler settings.
audit_member_text: [L75,L86,L163,L174] (MED/feature-configuration) Combined MPI_netcdf configurations omit the MPI and netCDF preprocessor definitions supplied in single-feature builds.

adversarial.rationale: This DLL project compiles only introspection.F90 and libxbeach_dynamic.F90, neither of which tests USEMPI, USENETCDF or their related feature macros. The wrapper calls the already compiled libxbeach_module, and the IFX static-library combined configurations explicitly enable both features (xbeachlibrary_IFX.vfproj:75,86,163,174), so missing unused DLL-local definitions do not remove feature support.
